column1: # tests/run-tasks-models.tsv - model seats offered by run-tasks-batch.ps1.
# A row belongs here only if tests/test-toolcalls.ps1 measured PASS for that
# tag on the listed host(s) (see docs/start-here.md + AGENTS.md Gotchas -
# models that fail the probe are never offered as seats). run-tasks-batch.ps1
# reads this and intersects it with what each live host serves (the engine
# adapter's served-model list), so:
#   - adding a new tool-capable model = one row here, the script is never edited
#   - a host that is down, or a tag not served there yet, stops being offered
# Columns: tag<TAB>engine<TAB>hosts<TAB>desc. engine = llamacpp | opencode-go:
# the serving engine, and with a host the seat's provider (llamacpp-<host>/<tag>).
# hosts = whitespace-separated host tokens (node3 | server) matching the
# LLAMACPP_<HOST>_BASE_URL env each profile exports. The 13 Ollama rows (desktop,
# node3 and server seats measured on Ollama) were removed with Ollama on
# 2026-11-21; a model comes back as a llama.cpp row after its own llama.cpp probe.
# Hosted seats are the exception: engine `opencode-go`, host token `opencode-go`,
# means the OpenCode Go subscription (model id opencode-go/<tag>), billed per
# token. Those rows were smoke-tested, NOT probed - the probe covers local engines
# only - each one wrote a file through `opencode run --auto` on 2026-10-06, and
# the owner approved them as seats. run-tasks-batch.ps1 offers one only when the
# agent lists it (Get-AgentProviderModels), the API key file exists and the live
# config resolves; never under 'all' (use -Models hosted, or name it), and never
# above its spend cap (-SpendCapShare of the monthly allowance in
# costs/go-rates.tsv; a seat with no rate row there is refused).
